labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.
This parameter is set automatically for this resource.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

wait_feature_status.title: Wait feature
wait_feature_status.description: Enable wait state insertion via the NWAIT signal when accessing the memory.

use_nand_ecc.title: Use error code correction (ECC)
use_nand_ecc.description: Enable ECC (Error Code Correction) management for this NAND instance.

ecc_algorithm.title: ECC algorithm mode
ecc_algorithm.description: Specifies the algorithm chosen for error code correction.

actions.message: This parameter is enabled when NAND ECC is used.

chunk_size_byte.title: Chunk of data size
chunk_size_byte.description: Size of chunks within a page when the sequencer or ECC is used.

actions.message: This parameter is enabled when NAND ECC is used, or when NAND DMA is active.
This parameter is unavailable when the ECC algorithm is set to BCH 8-bit or BCH 4-bit.
This parameter is unavailable when the ECC algorithm is set to BCH 8-bit or BCH 4-bit.
This parameter is unavailable when the ECC algorithm is set to BCH 8-bit or BCH 4-bit.
This parameter is unavailable when the ECC algorithm is set to BCH 8-bit or BCH 4-bit.

clock_source.title: Clock source
clock_source.description: Clock source can be modified in clock tree.

clock_source_frequency.title: Clock source frequency
clock_source_frequency.description: Input clock frequency can be modified in clock tree.

ecc_offset_byte.title: ECC offset
ecc_offset_byte.description: Spare area offset: this offset must not exceed the size of the spare area.

actions.message: This parameter is enabled when NAND ECC is used.

extra_command.title: Extra command
extra_command.description: Extra command is required for page reading mode.

actions.message: This parameter is unavailable when extra command is disabled.

tclr_setup_time_nsec.title: TCLR setup time
tclr_setup_time_nsec.description: Delay between CLE low and RE low.

tar_setup_time_nsec.title: TAR setup time
tar_setup_time_nsec.description: Delay between ALE low and RE low.

setup_time_ns.title: Setup time
setup_time_ns.description: Duration required to set up the address before the command assertion.

wait_time_ns.title: Wait time
wait_time_ns.description: Minimum duration of the command assertion.

hold_time_ns.title: Hold time
hold_time_ns.description: Duration for which the address must be held (as well as the data if a write access is performed) after the command deassertion.

hiz_time_ns.title: Data bus HI-Z time
hiz_time_ns.description: Duration for which the data bus is kept in high-Z state after a write access has started.

partition.title: Use default partition ONFI
partition.description: The partition parameters are retrieved automatically from NAND memory that is compliant with the Open NAND Flash Interface (ONFI) standard.

actions.message: This parameter is available when default ONFI partition is disabled.

block_nbr.title: Block number
block_nbr.description: Memory number of blocks per logic unit(LUN).

last_wr_access_timing.title: Last write access timing
last_wr_access_timing.description: Enable the last write access timing when different timing configuration for the last write  access is required.

actions.message: This parameter is available when last write access timing is true.

setup_time_ns.title: Setup time
setup_time_ns.description: Duration required to set up the address before the command assertion.

wait_time_ns.title: Wait time
wait_time_ns.description: Minimum duration of the command assertion.

hold_time_ns.title: Hold time
hold_time_ns.description: Duration for which the address must be held (as well as the data if a write access is performed) after the command deassertion.

hiz_time_ns.title: Data bus HI-Z time
hiz_time_ns.description: Duration for which the data bus is kept in high-Z state after a write access has started.

actions.message: This parameter is available when DMA program or DMA read is enabled.

chu_xfer_cplt.title: Sequencer interrupt: chunk of data transfer complete
chu_xfer_cplt.description: This interrupt should only be enabled when the sequencer is used to detect the chunk transfer complete.

seq_ecc_chu_err.title: Sequencer interrupt: chunk of data ECC error
seq_ecc_chu_err.description: This interrupt should only be enabled when the sequencer is used with ECC to detect at least one error once the chunk transfer is completed.

actions.message: This parameter is available when error correction code (ECC) or DMA ECC is enabled.

seq_ecc_chu_uunco_err.title: Sequencer interrupt: chunk of data ECC uncorrectable error
seq_ecc_chu_uunco_err.description: This interrupt should only be enabled when the sequencer is used with ECC to detect an uncorrectable error once a chunk transfer is completed .

actions.message: This parameter is available when error correction code (ECC) or DMA ECC is enabled.

security_privilege.title: Security and privilege
security_privilege.#comment: Use for instance for FMC NAND
security_privilege.description: Manage security and privileged access levels attributes.

security.title: Security attribute
security.description: Set the security attribute of the securable peripheral.

actions.message: The security attribute of the peripheral is automatically set to secure when the peripheral is bound to a secure resource and to non-secure when it is not. Manual configuration is not allowed.

privilege.title: Privilege attribute
privilege.description: Set the privilege attribute of a securable RISC peripheral.

lock.title: Lock
lock.description: Optional. Lock security and privilege attributes to prevent changes.

actions.message: Secure-only mode: Illegal access interrupt is forced to disabled.

dma_program.title: DMA program
dma_program.description: The program channel is dedicated to transferring data to the NAND memory. To ensure correct data transfer, the DMA must be configured in repeated block mode, also referred to as 2D addressing.

dma_read.title: DMA read
dma_read.description: The read channel is dedicated to transferring data from the NAND memory. To ensure correct data transfer, the DMA must be configured in repeated block mode, also referred to as 2D addressing.

dma_ecc.title: DMA ECC
dma_ecc.description: The ECC channel is dedicated to transferring ECC decoding results.

actions.message: This parameter is enabled when NAND ECC is used.

attributes.description: The 'Interrupt' must be configured whenever any interrupt source is enabled
